    {

        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"

      "output_key": "entities",

      "reasoning": "High priority rule for the most frequent entity in the dataset. The lookbehind ensures it's used in a legal context (e.g., 'des Obersten Gerichtshofs') rather than as a random word."

        "text": "$0",

        "type": "organisation"

      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"

      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 8,

      "name": "Match Bezirksgerichte (District Courts)",

      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"

      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 7,

    },
    {

      "description": "Captures Commercial Courts.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?i)(?:des|dem|an|in|vom|am|gegen|mit|nach|bei|durch|über|unter|vor|zu|als|für|von)\bHandelsgerichts(?:\b(?:Wien))",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 6,
      "reasoning": "Specific rule for Commercial Courts found in the training data."
    },
    {
      "name": "Match Law Firms and Companies (GmbH/OG/KG/SE)",

      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?i)(?:vertreten durch)\b([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\\s.,&]+(?:GmbH|RzAnwGmbH|RzAnwPartnerschaft|RzAnwOG|RzAnwKG|RzAnwSE|RzAnwGmbH))",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 5,
      "reasoning": "Matches organizations preceded by 'vertreten durch' (represented by), which is a strong contextual signal for legal entities in this domain. Uses capture group $1 to extract just the entity name."
    },
    {
      "name": "Match VwGH (Administrative Court)",
      "description": "Captures the Administrative Court abbreviation.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?i)(?:des\\s+)?VwGH\\b",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 4,
      "reasoning": "Specific rule for the Administrative Court abbreviation found in the training data."
    }
  ],
  "deleted_rules": []
}
